cohort: The study included 151 asymptomatic full-term neonates (37-42 weeks gestational age) without a history of intrauterine growth retardation, birth asphyxia, premature rupture of membranes, or gestational diabetes mellitus.
finding: The overall frequency of hypoglycemia in asymptomatic, full-term neonates within the first hour of life was 15.2%, with low birth weight and delayed breastfeeding identified as significant independent risk factors.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was not significantly associated with the development of hypoglycemia.
cross-section timing: within the first hour of birth
